title: Faith and God’s Promises
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner describes the background to the call of Abraham (Ur, Haran, Terah's family, other gods; Joshua 24:2) and examines how he showed faith (leaving home, waiting for Isaac, offering Isaac in Genesis 22; Hebrews 11:8-12, 17-19).

floor.question: What did God promise Abram in Genesis 12:2?
floor.answer: To make him a great nation

steps: Faith: offering Isaac; God provides a ram.
contexts: waiting for an answer to prayer

board.do: Draw a time line from 75 to 100.

board.say: What happened when Abraham was a hundred?

board.do: Wait for the learner to say Isaac was born.

misconceptions.ask: What did God tell Abram to do?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 12:1: "Go from your country". Mark Ur, Haran and Canaan on a map.

misconceptions.ask: What animal did Abraham find to offer instead of Isaac (Genesis 22:13)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 22:8 and 22:13: Abraham said a lamb; God provided a ram caught by its horns.

misconceptions.ask: How did Abraham respond to God's call?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 12:4 and Hebrews 11:8: "Abram went"; by faith he obeyed.

listen_for: Still young, soon after the call
misconceptions.ask: How old was Abraham when Isaac was born (Genesis 21:5)?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a time line: called at 75, Isaac born at 100. Faith means waiting for God's promise.

checks.question: What did God tell Abram to do in Genesis 12:1?
checks.answer: Leave his country for a land God would show him

checks.question: What did God provide instead of Isaac?

skills.key_step: The learner elaborates God's promises to Abraham (a great nation, a great name, many descendants like the stars, land, blessing to all peoples; Genesis 12:2-3, 15:5, 17:8) and explains their importance to Christians today (God keeps his word; blessing through Christ; Galatians 3:8).

floor.question: What did God provide instead of Isaac?

representations: a night sky drawn with stars
contexts: a church far from Israel blessed through Christ

board.do: Draw a night sky full of stars.

board.say: What did God promise Abram with these?

board.do: Wait for the learner to say many descendants.
List all the promises beside the sky.

misconceptions.ask: Which was a promise to Abraham?
misconceptions.repair: List the promises of Genesis 12:2-3, 15:5, 17:8: great nation, many descendants, land, blessing to all nations.

misconceptions.ask: Who would be blessed through Abraham?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 12:3: "all peoples on earth will be blessed through you". Link to Galatians 3:8.

misconceptions.ask: Why do Christians value God's promises?
misconceptions.repair: Show that God kept his promises to Abraham; Christians trust the same God (2 Corinthians 1:20).

misconceptions.ask: What did God tell Abram to count to show how many descendants he would have (Genesis 15:5)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 15:5 at night if possible: count the stars. Rainbow belongs to Noah (Genesis 9).

checks.question: Name one promise God made to Abraham.
Who would be blessed through Abraham?
